posts.text: Kalshi: flow gate live. Price cuts (idle step, aggressive reprice, FILLFAIR) are now OFF until 30% of a sport's crowd flow has arrived, half-speed to 60%, normal after; wired in NASCAR, NFL and UFC. O'Reilly relaid at capped prices, Truck deployed off Bovada at 4:28pm, Cup restarted with orders kept and the Logano reject loop fixed. Doc: research/FLOW-GATED-REPRICING-2026-10-20.md
